reviewMethod: Agent manual inspection of all twenty unique public reference/transcript pairs plus comparison of all forty outputs across passes; agent review, not user/human/blinded acceptance.
scope: 20 known synthetic Samantha TTS fixtures replayed twice; not held-out human speech and not microphone/stop-to-final latency.
prepareCaveat: First prepare in this test process; OS/CoreML caches uncontrolled; prepare includes internal warmup
timingMethod: ContinuousClock file-recovery durations. p50 midpoint median; p95/p99 nearest rank. n=10 per group makes tail percentiles maxima and directional only. Initial short includes first replay.
qualitySummary: No negation flip, number magnitude change, lost final words or reordered/lost sentence content observed in this limited corpus.
Repeated lexical/entity/correction/address defects in fixtures 01,02,06,19; fixture12 adds currency notation needing review.
Raw ASR preservation must not be scored against cleanup references; no normalized WER or comparable baseline was computed.
No real clipped-endpoint/drain, silence, microphone, streaming, resource, or destination gate established.
Quotation oh wait preserved in fixtures10/18, unchanged from prior ASR run. File replay does not validate live stop/drain endpoint safety.

Open Xway becomes opens way, address is becomes addresses, and example dot com slash draft becomes example.com/slash draft rather than a faithful spoken address or example.com/draft. Identifier and false preserved.
All sentences retained in order; final do not delete the backup intact, colon becomes full stop.

decision: Continue A00 with persistent lexical/entity/correction defects recorded; faster signed replay is actual file-recovery measurement, not live stop latency or gate closure.

comparison.observation: All lexical/entity/correction/URL/currency issues persist. Fixture12 punctuation additionally merges final statement and every sentence clauses; no new lexical semantic change observed. All 20 fixture outputs identical between initial and warm passes in this run.
comparison.environmentContextReportedByIntegrator: Signed run followed freeing approximately 51 GiB disk space; earlier run encountered disk-related compilation failures. Signing/cache/disk/workload conditions differ, so the latency difference is not attributable to signing or a source optimization.
